title: Big Food vs. The People
excerpt: We expose Big Food’s 239 lawsuits against life-saving policies
content_html:
Bad diets kill millions of people globally every year, and lead to tens of billions of dollars in health costs, often placing the heaviest burden on communities who are least able to afford it. Children, with limited decision-making power, are particularly vulnerable to this.

Legislators and government officials have worked to rein in this public health crisis by enacting laws that require food companies to be transparent about their ingredients and limit the advertising of unhealthy foods.

In public, the world’s biggest and richest food companies such as Coca Cola, PepsiCola, and Mondelez say they want to be part of the solution. But behind closed doors, they have taken governments to court to delay, dilute, and derail public health laws, which the companies say violate their rights.

This cross border collaboration with health academics and an international media coalition shed light on how transnational corporations use legal tactics – lawsuits and legal threats – to stymie public health efforts in six countries where such tactics are most apparent: Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, India, Britain, and the United States.

We found:

– 239 lawsuits were filed between 2010 and 2025 across Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, the US, the UK, and India against public health policies targeting food and beverages such as front of pack labelling, regulating advertising junk food to children, soda taxes, and taxes on ultra processed foods.

– The cases add up to 595 years of litigation, representing a significant burden on the governments defending their health policies.

– Of the cases brought by private companies where the plaintiff was identifiable, more than 1 in 3 came from just nine parent groups, led by Coca-Cola, PepsiCo, and Mondelez

Their actions are not only prolonging the public health crisis but also cost countries billions of dollars in both legal and healthcare costs. In addition, they have a chilling effect on policymakers that wish to better their citizens’ health but do not have the resources to engage in drawn-out legal fights with food companies.

METHODS

We constructed a dataset of challenges to laws aiming to improve population nutrition between 2010 and 2025 in these countries: Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, U.S., UK, and India.

With the exception of India, cases were included when a regulation that sought to improve public health through better nutrition was being challenged (i.e. validity, scope, or implementation). We made an exception for cases in India where influencers were being sued, as they were taking over the role of the government in making the nutritional value of products more transparent.

We only included cases that were verifiable through official legal databases, court records, or reputable secondary sources.

We excluded cases solely concerning non-manufacturers such as fresh produce or when companies were appealing fines and other judgments unrelated to public health policies.

This research was done in collaboration with researchers from the University of Caldas (Colombia); Robert & Ethel Kennedy Human Rights Center (United States); the University of Sao Paulo (Brazil); and the University of Sydney (Australia). They found more lawsuits through a systematic legal search in Colombia, Brazil and Mexico.

An upcoming academic paper will be published alongside the media articles, looking at the dataset from a scientific perspective.

This dataset built on the work and insight of El Poder del Consumidor (Mexico), the FULL database developed by the Global Center for Legal Innovation on Food Environments at the O’Neill Institute and the Global Health Advocacy Incubator, CAJAR (Colombia), and ACT (Brazil).

STORYLINES

– Mexico

More than a third of Mexican schoolchildren and 41% of adolescents were overweight according to a 2022 national survey.

This is the country where we found the most lawsuits (193 out of 239), many of them were against the country’s labelling regulation. Quinto Elemento Lab reveals the companies’ arguments: that the laws were a violation of their constitutional rights and that the measures “demonized” their products or violated consumer rights. For example, a local Pepsi bottler argued that in certain rural areas of Mexico, it was safer to drink soft drinks than the available water. In court, the judges rejected many of the legal arguments that the companies presented.

– Brazil

According to the UN, in 2022-2024, more than 1 in 4 adults in Brazil were living with obesity while nearly 1 in 9 children were overweight.

Some of the 17 lawsuits in Brazil have been dragging on for close to a couple of decades, with no predicted conclusion in sight, according to Agência Pública and O Joio e O Trigo.

In all but one, the plaintiffs were industry associations, which experts told us is a way for companies to keep their valuable brand names away from litigation that may harm their image. Some of the world’s largest food companies are members of these Brazilian associations, including Coca-Cola, Ferrero, Kellogg’s local brand, Mars, Mondelez, Nestlé, and PepsiCo. 11 of the lawsuits were against the Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency, ANVISA, which has been hamstrung as a result. The plaintiffs disputed a regulation that required the advertising of food and beverages with low nutritional value to display more information.

– Colombia

More than half of Colombia’s population is overweight, and treating the diseases caused by unhealthy foods cost the country an estimated 1.3 billion euros in 2021.

We found 18 lawsuits in Colombia, mostly targeting taxes on unhealthy products and front-of-package labelling. Nearly all of them were constitutional challenges brought about by individual citizens as enabled in the country’s constitution. However, Cuestión Pública finds that many of the plaintiffs were lawyers who had done work for food companies. The submissions also used many of the same arguments wielded by the companies. In 2022, while the creation of the health tax was being debated, sugary beverage and ultra-processed food companies donated 5.85 million Euros to political parties, accounting for 40% of all donations to political parties that year.

– U.S.

Two in three adults in the U.S. are overweight and a quarter of adolescents are living with obesity, according to the CDC. The Make America Healthy Again movement supported Trump’s presidency bid.

The American Beverage Association sued to overturn a soda tax in Santa Cruz, which it has so far failed to do. Santa Cruz Local uncovers details of the group’s earlier success squashing a soda tax effort in Watsonville, a neighbouring city. The Santa Cruz lawsuit has far-reaching consequences: the recent victory for the city could unlock the ability for charter cities across California to tax sugary beverages. We found that the soda industry recruited and leveraged the credibility of prominent Black and Latino leaders to amplify opposition against public health taxes within their own communities. We have also identified five other lawsuits. The ABA was involved in four of them.

– Europe

In Europe, non-communicable diseases (NCDs) such as cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, or cancer are responsible for 80% of the disease burden, according to the European Commission.

Follow The Money discovers that European countries have struggled to pass taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages, as they come under industry pressure. Unlike in Latin America, European governments frequently face legal threats before legislation is adopted. Industry groups repeatedly invoke EU state-aid, competition and internal-market rules, creating uncertainty that can delay or derail policies without a single lawsuit being filed. Plans for a joint European sugar tax have also been weakened.

L’Espresso and Il Fatto Alimentare explain the role Italian confectionary giant Ferrero plays around the world in stimying public health laws, and how the family-owned company’s influence both domestically and internationally is connected to the country’s agroindustry rather than its famous cuisine.

– England

As of 2024, 66% of adults and 26% of children in England were either overweight or living with obesity, according to the National Health Service.

In 2021, a year before Kellogg’s sued – and lost – against the country’s nutrient profiling model contained in the Food (Promotion and Placement) (England) Regulations 2021, it sent a pre-action letter to the Department of Health and Social Care, claiming the health rating of its cereals should be measured with the milk it is usually consumed with.

A mere two weeks before the ruling against Kellogg’s, Ferrero and Eat Natural, a subsidiary of Ferrero, also sent pre-action letters over the same regulations.

– India

Nearly one in three Indian women and more than one in four men are overweight or obese. One in five people have high blood sugar levels.

The Wire traces the long journey of India’s front of pack labeling regulation, which the Indian food regulator, the FSSAI, has been developing since 2014. Over that time, it has done numerous consultations, studies but it has stalled regulating, blaming a lack of consensus between the industry and civil society. Research by ATNi commissioned by Lighthouse Reports showed that India’s proposed labelling system is actually consistently more lenient compared to similar systems in Australia and France.

Meanwhile, influential instagram celebrities have made videos comparing the nutrition of various products such as instant noodles, baby food, and others. They’ve been sued by the companies whose ingredient labels they were analysing.

blocks.html_en: – Mexico

sentences.en: – Mexico
sentences.zh: - 墨西哥

blocks.html_en: More than a third of Mexican schoolchildren and 41% of adolescents were overweight according to a 2022 national survey.

sentences.en: More than a third of Mexican schoolchildren and 41% of adolescents were overweight according to a 2022 national survey.
sentences.zh: 根据 2022 年的一项全国调查，超过三分之一的墨西哥学童和 41% 的青少年体重超重。

blocks.html_en: This is the country where we found the most lawsuits (193 out of 239), many of them were against the country’s labelling regulation. Quinto Elemento Lab reveals the companies’ arguments: that the laws were a violation of their constitutional rights and that the measures “demonized” their products or violated consumer rights. For example, a local Pepsi bottler argued that in certain rural areas of Mexico, it was safer to drink soft drinks than the available water. In court, the judges rejected many of the legal arguments that the companies presented.

sentences.en: This is the country where we found the most lawsuits (193 out of 239), many of them were against the country’s labelling regulation.
sentences.zh: 这是我们发现诉讼最多的国家（239 起诉讼中有 193 起），其中许多是针对该国标签法规的。

sentences.en: Quinto Elemento Lab reveals the companies’ arguments: that the laws were a violation of their constitutional rights and that the measures “demonized” their products or violated consumer rights.
sentences.zh: Quinto Elemento Lab 揭示了这些公司的论点：这些法律侵犯了他们的宪法权利，这些措施“妖魔化”了他们的产品或侵犯了消费者权利。

sentences.en: For example, a local Pepsi bottler argued that in certain rural areas of Mexico, it was safer to drink soft drinks than the available water.
sentences.zh: 例如，当地的百事可乐装瓶商认为，在墨西哥的某些农村地区，喝软饮料比现有的水更安全。

sentences.en: In court, the judges rejected many of the legal arguments that the companies presented.
sentences.zh: 在法庭上，法官驳回了这些公司提出的许多法律论点。

blocks.html_en: – Brazil

sentences.en: – Brazil
sentences.zh: - 巴西

blocks.html_en: According to the UN, in 2022-2024, more than 1 in 4 adults in Brazil were living with obesity while nearly 1 in 9 children were overweight.

sentences.en: According to the UN, in 2022-2024, more than 1 in 4 adults in Brazil were living with obesity while nearly 1 in 9 children were overweight.
sentences.zh: 据联合国称，2022年至2024年，巴西超过四分之一的成年人患有肥胖症，而近九分之一的儿童超重。

blocks.html_en: Some of the 17 lawsuits in Brazil have been dragging on for close to a couple of decades, with no predicted conclusion in sight, according to Agência Pública and O Joio e O Trigo.

sentences.en: Some of the 17 lawsuits in Brazil have been dragging on for close to a couple of decades, with no predicted conclusion in sight, according to Agência Pública and O Joio e O Trigo.
sentences.zh: 据 Agência Pública 和 O Joio e O Trigo 称，巴西的 17 起诉讼中有一些已经拖延了近几十年，目前还看不到预期的结论。

blocks.html_en: In all but one, the plaintiffs were industry associations, which experts told us is a way for companies to keep their valuable brand names away from litigation that may harm their image. Some of the world’s largest food companies are members of these Brazilian associations, including Coca-Cola, Ferrero, Kellogg’s local brand, Mars, Mondelez, Nestlé, and PepsiCo. 11 of the lawsuits were against the Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency, ANVISA, which has been hamstrung as a result. The plaintiffs disputed a regulation that required the advertising of food and beverages with low nutritional value to display more information.

sentences.en: In all but one, the plaintiffs were industry associations, which experts told us is a way for companies to keep their valuable brand names away from litigation that may harm their image.
sentences.zh: 除了其中一个之外，所有案件的原告都是行业协会，专家告诉我们，这是公司避免其有价值的品牌名称受到可能损害其形象的诉讼的一种方式。

sentences.en: Some of the world’s largest food companies are members of these Brazilian associations, including Coca-Cola, Ferrero, Kellogg’s local brand, Mars, Mondelez, Nestlé, and PepsiCo.
sentences.zh: 一些世界上最大的食品公司都是这些巴西协会的成员，包括可口可乐、费列罗、家乐氏本土品牌、玛氏、亿滋、雀巢和百事可乐。

sentences.en: 11 of the lawsuits were against the Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency, ANVISA, which has been hamstrung as a result.
sentences.zh: 其中 11 起诉讼是针对巴西卫生监管机构 ANVISA，该机构因此陷入困境。

sentences.en: The plaintiffs disputed a regulation that required the advertising of food and beverages with low nutritional value to display more information.
sentences.zh: 原告对一项要求低营养价值食品和饮料的广告显示更多信息的规定提出异议。

blocks.html_en: – Colombia

sentences.en: – Colombia
sentences.zh: – 哥伦比亚

blocks.html_en: More than half of Colombia’s population is overweight, and treating the diseases caused by unhealthy foods cost the country an estimated 1.3 billion euros in 2021.

sentences.en: More than half of Colombia’s population is overweight, and treating the diseases caused by unhealthy foods cost the country an estimated 1.3 billion euros in 2021.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚一半以上的人口超重，到 2021 年，治疗不健康食品引起的疾病估计花费该国 13 亿欧元。

blocks.html_en: We found 18 lawsuits in Colombia, mostly targeting taxes on unhealthy products and front-of-package labelling. Nearly all of them were constitutional challenges brought about by individual citizens as enabled in the country’s constitution. However, Cuestión Pública finds that many of the plaintiffs were lawyers who had done work for food companies. The submissions also used many of the same arguments wielded by the companies. In 2022, while the creation of the health tax was being debated, sugary beverage and ultra-processed food companies donated 5.85 million Euros to political parties, accounting for 40% of all donations to political parties that year.

sentences.en: We found 18 lawsuits in Colombia, mostly targeting taxes on unhealthy products and front-of-package labelling.
sentences.zh: 我们在哥伦比亚发现了 18 起诉讼，主要针对不健康产品和包装正面标签征税。

sentences.en: Nearly all of them were constitutional challenges brought about by individual citizens as enabled in the country’s constitution.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有这些都是国家宪法赋予公民个人带来的宪法挑战。

sentences.en: However, Cuestión Pública finds that many of the plaintiffs were lawyers who had done work for food companies.
sentences.zh: 然而，Cuestión Pública 发现，许多原告都是曾在食品公司工作过的律师。

sentences.en: The submissions also used many of the same arguments wielded by the companies.
sentences.zh: 这些意见书还使用了许多与这些公司相同的论点。

sentences.en: In 2022, while the creation of the health tax was being debated, sugary beverage and ultra-processed food companies donated 5.85 million Euros to political parties, accounting for 40% of all donations to political parties that year.
sentences.zh: 2022年，当健康税的设立还在争论中时，含糖饮料和超加工食品公司向政党捐赠了585万欧元，占当年政党捐赠总额的40%。

blocks.html_en: Two in three adults in the U.S. are overweight and a quarter of adolescents are living with obesity, according to the CDC. The Make America Healthy Again movement supported Trump’s presidency bid.

sentences.en: Two in three adults in the U.S. are overweight and a quarter of adolescents are living with obesity, according to the CDC.
sentences.zh: 根据疾病预防控制中心的数据，美国三分之二的成年人超重，四分之一的青少年肥胖。

sentences.en: The Make America Healthy Again movement supported Trump’s presidency bid.
sentences.zh: “让美国再次健康”运动支持特朗普竞选总统。

blocks.html_en: The American Beverage Association sued to overturn a soda tax in Santa Cruz, which it has so far failed to do. Santa Cruz Local uncovers details of the group’s earlier success squashing a soda tax effort in Watsonville, a neighbouring city. The Santa Cruz lawsuit has far-reaching consequences: the recent victory for the city could unlock the ability for charter cities across California to tax sugary beverages. We found that the soda industry recruited and leveraged the credibility of prominent Black and Latino leaders to amplify opposition against public health taxes within their own communities. We have also identified five other lawsuits. The ABA was involved in four of them.

sentences.en: The American Beverage Association sued to overturn a soda tax in Santa Cruz, which it has so far failed to do.
sentences.zh: 美国饮料协会提起诉讼，要求推翻圣克鲁斯的苏打税，但迄今为止尚未成功。

sentences.en: Santa Cruz Local uncovers details of the group’s earlier success squashing a soda tax effort in Watsonville, a neighbouring city.
sentences.zh: Santa Cruz Local 揭露了该组织早期成功压制邻近城市沃森维尔苏打税行动的细节。

sentences.en: The Santa Cruz lawsuit has far-reaching consequences: the recent victory for the city could unlock the ability for charter cities across California to tax sugary beverages.
sentences.zh: 圣克鲁斯诉讼具有深远的影响：该市最近的胜利可能会释放加州特许城市对含糖饮料征税的能力。

sentences.en: We found that the soda industry recruited and leveraged the credibility of prominent Black and Latino leaders to amplify opposition against public health taxes within their own communities.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，汽水行业招募并利用了著名的黑人和拉丁裔领导人的信誉，以放大他们自己社区内对公共卫生税的反对。

sentences.en: We have also identified five other lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 我们还确定了其他五起诉讼。

sentences.en: The ABA was involved in four of them.
sentences.zh: ABA 参与了其中四起案件。

sentences.en: – Europe

blocks.html_en: In Europe, non-communicable diseases (NCDs) such as cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, or cancer are responsible for 80% of the disease burden, according to the European Commission.

sentences.en: In Europe, non-communicable diseases (NCDs) such as cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, or cancer are responsible for 80% of the disease burden, according to the European Commission.
sentences.zh: 据欧盟委员会称，在欧洲，心血管疾病、糖尿病或癌症等非传染性疾病 (NCD) 造成了 80% 的疾病负担。

blocks.html_en: Follow The Money discovers that European countries have struggled to pass taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages, as they come under industry pressure. Unlike in Latin America, European governments frequently face legal threats before legislation is adopted. Industry groups repeatedly invoke EU state-aid, competition and internal-market rules, creating uncertainty that can delay or derail policies without a single lawsuit being filed. Plans for a joint European sugar tax have also been weakened.

sentences.en: Follow The Money discovers that European countries have struggled to pass taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages, as they come under industry pressure.
sentences.zh: 《Follow The Money》发现，由于面临行业压力，欧洲国家一直在努力通过对含糖饮料征税。

sentences.en: Unlike in Latin America, European governments frequently face legal threats before legislation is adopted.
sentences.zh: 与拉丁美洲不同，欧洲政府在立法通过之前经常面临法律威胁。

sentences.en: Industry groups repeatedly invoke EU state-aid, competition and internal-market rules, creating uncertainty that can delay or derail policies without a single lawsuit being filed.
sentences.zh: 行业组织一再援引欧盟国家援助、竞争和内部市场规则，造成不确定性，可能在不提起任何诉讼的情况下推迟或破坏政策。

sentences.en: Plans for a joint European sugar tax have also been weakened.
sentences.zh: 欧洲联合征收糖税的计划也被削弱。

blocks.html_en: L’Espresso and Il Fatto Alimentare explain the role Italian confectionary giant Ferrero plays around the world in stimying public health laws, and how the family-owned company’s influence both domestically and internationally is connected to the country’s agroindustry rather than its famous cuisine.

sentences.en: L’Espresso and Il Fatto Alimentare explain the role Italian confectionary giant Ferrero plays around the world in stimying public health laws, and how the family-owned company’s influence both domestically and internationally is connected to the country’s agroindustry rather than its famous cuisine.
sentences.zh: L’Espresso 和 Il Fatto Alimentare 解释了意大利糖果巨头费列罗在世界各地推动公共卫生法方面所发挥的作用，以及这家家族企业在国内和国际上的影响力如何与该国的农工业而不是其著名的美食有关。

blocks.html_en: As of 2024, 66% of adults and 26% of children in England were either overweight or living with obesity, according to the National Health Service.

sentences.zh: 根据英国国家卫生服务中心的数据，截至 2024 年，英格兰 66% 的成年人和 26% 的儿童超重或肥胖。

blocks.html_en: In 2021, a year before Kellogg’s sued – and lost – against the country’s nutrient profiling model contained in the Food (Promotion and Placement) (England) Regulations 2021, it sent a pre-action letter to the Department of Health and Social Care, claiming the health rating of its cereals should be measured with the milk it is usually consumed with.

sentences.en: In 2021, a year before Kellogg’s sued – and lost – against the country’s nutrient profiling model contained in the Food (Promotion and Placement) (England) Regulations 2021, it sent a pre-action letter to the Department of Health and Social Care, claiming the health rating of its cereals should be measured with the milk it is usually consumed with.
sentences.zh: 2021 年，即家乐氏针对《2021 年食品（促销和安置）（英格兰）条例》中包含的国家营养分析模型提起诉讼并败诉的前一年，该公司向卫生和社会保障部发出了一封行动前信，声称其谷物的健康评级应与其通常食用的牛奶一起衡量。

blocks.html_en: A mere two weeks before the ruling against Kellogg’s, Ferrero and Eat Natural, a subsidiary of Ferrero, also sent pre-action letters over the same regulations.

sentences.en: A mere two weeks before the ruling against Kellogg’s, Ferrero and Eat Natural, a subsidiary of Ferrero, also sent pre-action letters over the same regulations.
sentences.zh: 就在对家乐氏做出裁决前两周，费列罗和费列罗子公司 Eat Natural 也针对相同规定发出了诉前信函。

blocks.html_en: The Wire traces the long journey of India’s front of pack labeling regulation, which the Indian food regulator, the FSSAI, has been developing since 2014. Over that time, it has done numerous consultations, studies but it has stalled regulating, blaming a lack of consensus between the industry and civil society. Research by ATNi commissioned by Lighthouse Reports showed that India’s proposed labelling system is actually consistently more lenient compared to similar systems in Australia and France.

content_html_zh:
不良饮食每年导致全球数百万人死亡，并导致数百亿美元的健康成本，往往给最无力承担的社区带来最沉重的负担。 决策权有限的儿童尤其容易受到这种影响。

立法者和政府官员通过颁布法律要求食品公司对其成分保持透明并限制不健康食品的广告来努力控制这场公共卫生危机。

可口可乐、百事可乐和亿滋等全球最大、最富有的食品公司在公开场合表示，他们希望成为解决方案的一部分。 但他们私下将政府告上法庭，要求政府推迟、淡化和破坏公共卫生法，这些公司称这些法律侵犯了他们的权利。

与健康学者和国际媒体联盟的跨境合作揭示了跨国公司如何利用法律策略（诉讼和法律威胁）来阻碍墨西哥、巴西、哥伦比亚、印度、英国和美国等六个国家的公共卫生工作，这些国家的此类策略最为明显。

我们发现：

– 2010 年至 2025 年间，墨西哥、哥伦比亚、巴西、美国、英国和印度针对针对食品和饮料的公共卫生政策提起了 239 起诉讼，例如包装正面标签、监管儿童垃圾食品广告、苏打税和超加工食品税。

– 这些案件加起来长达 595 年的诉讼，对捍卫其卫生政策的政府来说是沉重的负担。

– 在可识别原告的私营公司提起的案件中，超过三分之一来自九个母集团，其中可口可乐、百事可乐和亿滋为首

他们的行为不仅延长了公共卫生危机，还让各国损失了数十亿美元的法律和医疗费用。 此外，它们对希望改善公民健康但没有资源与食品公司进行旷日持久的法律斗争的政策制定者产生了寒蝉效应。

方法

我们构建了墨西哥、哥伦比亚、巴西、美国、英国和印度等国家 2010 年至 2025 年间旨在改善人口营养的法律挑战数据集。

除印度外，还纳入了旨在通过改善营养改善公共卫生的法规受到挑战（即有效性、范围或实施）的案例。 我们对印度影响者被起诉的案例进行了例外处理，因为他们正在接管政府的角色，使产品的营养价值更加透明。

我们只纳入可通过官方法律数据库、法庭记录或信誉良好的二手来源核实的案件。

我们排除了仅涉及新鲜农产品等非制造商的案件，或者公司对罚款和与公共卫生政策无关的其他判决提出上诉的案件。

这项研究是与卡尔达斯大学（哥伦比亚）的研究人员合作完成的；罗伯特和埃塞尔·肯尼迪人权中心（美国）；圣保罗大学（巴西）；和悉尼大学（澳大利亚）。 他们通过系统的法律搜索在哥伦比亚、巴西和墨西哥发现了更多诉讼。

即将发表的学术论文将与媒体文章一起发表，从科学角度审视数据集。

该数据集基于 El Poder del Consumidor（墨西哥）的工作和见解、由奥尼尔研究所全球食品环境法律创新中心和全球健康倡导孵化器、CAJAR（哥伦比亚）和 ACT（巴西）开发的 FULL 数据库。

故事情节

- 墨西哥

根据 2022 年的一项全国调查，超过三分之一的墨西哥学童和 41% 的青少年体重超重。

这是我们发现诉讼最多的国家（239 起诉讼中有 193 起），其中许多是针对该国标签法规的。 Quinto Elemento Lab 揭示了这些公司的论点：这些法律侵犯了他们的宪法权利，这些措施“妖魔化”了他们的产品或侵犯了消费者权利。 例如，当地的百事可乐装瓶商认为，在墨西哥的某些农村地区，喝软饮料比现有的水更安全。 在法庭上，法官驳回了这些公司提出的许多法律论点。

- 巴西

据联合国称，2022年至2024年，巴西超过四分之一的成年人患有肥胖症，而近九分之一的儿童超重。

据 Agência Pública 和 O Joio e O Trigo 称，巴西的 17 起诉讼中有一些已经拖延了近几十年，目前还看不到预期的结论。

除了其中一个之外，所有案件的原告都是行业协会，专家告诉我们，这是公司避免其有价值的品牌名称受到可能损害其形象的诉讼的一种方式。 一些世界上最大的食品公司都是这些巴西协会的成员，包括可口可乐、费列罗、家乐氏本土品牌、玛氏、亿滋、雀巢和百事可乐。 其中 11 起诉讼是针对巴西卫生监管机构 ANVISA，该机构因此陷入困境。 原告对一项要求低营养价值食品和饮料的广告显示更多信息的规定提出异议。

– 哥伦比亚

哥伦比亚一半以上的人口超重，到 2021 年，治疗不健康食品引起的疾病估计花费该国 13 亿欧元。

我们在哥伦比亚发现了 18 起诉讼，主要针对不健康产品和包装正面标签征税。 几乎所有这些都是国家宪法赋予公民个人带来的宪法挑战。 然而，Cuestión Pública 发现，许多原告都是曾在食品公司工作过的律师。 这些意见书还使用了许多与这些公司相同的论点。 2022年，当健康税的设立还在争论中时，含糖饮料和超加工食品公司向政党捐赠了585万欧元，占当年政党捐赠总额的40%。

– U.S.

根据疾病预防控制中心的数据，美国三分之二的成年人超重，四分之一的青少年肥胖。 “让美国再次健康”运动支持特朗普竞选总统。

美国饮料协会提起诉讼，要求推翻圣克鲁斯的苏打税，但迄今为止尚未成功。 Santa Cruz Local 揭露了该组织早期成功压制邻近城市沃森维尔苏打税行动的细节。 圣克鲁斯诉讼具有深远的影响：该市最近的胜利可能会释放加州特许城市对含糖饮料征税的能力。 我们发现，汽水行业招募并利用了著名的黑人和拉丁裔领导人的信誉，以放大他们自己社区内对公共卫生税的反对。 我们还确定了其他五起诉讼。 ABA 参与了其中四起案件。

- 欧洲

据欧盟委员会称，在欧洲，心血管疾病、糖尿病或癌症等非传染性疾病 (NCD) 造成了 80% 的疾病负担。

《Follow The Money》发现，由于面临行业压力，欧洲国家一直在努力通过对含糖饮料征税。 与拉丁美洲不同，欧洲政府在立法通过之前经常面临法律威胁。 行业组织一再援引欧盟国家援助、竞争和内部市场规则，造成不确定性，可能在不提起任何诉讼的情况下推迟或破坏政策。 欧洲联合征收糖税的计划也被削弱。

L’Espresso 和 Il Fatto Alimentare 解释了意大利糖果巨头费列罗在世界各地推动公共卫生法方面所发挥的作用，以及这家家族企业在国内和国际上的影响力如何与该国的农工业而不是其著名的美食有关。

- 英格兰

根据英国国家卫生服务中心的数据，截至 2024 年，英格兰 66% 的成年人和 26% 的儿童超重或肥胖。

2021 年，即家乐氏针对《2021 年食品（促销和安置）（英格兰）条例》中包含的国家营养分析模型提起诉讼并败诉的前一年，该公司向卫生和社会保障部发出了一封行动前信，声称其谷物的健康评级应与其通常食用的牛奶一起衡量。

就在对家乐氏做出裁决前两周，费列罗和费列罗子公司 Eat Natural 也针对相同规定发出了诉前信函。

– India

近三分之一的印度女性和超过四分之一的男性超重或肥胖。 五分之一的人血糖水平较高。

《连线》追踪了印度包装正面标签法规的漫长历程，该法规是印度食品监管机构 FSSAI 自 2014 年以来一直在制定的。 在那段时间里，它进行了大量的咨询和研究，但由于行业和民间社会之间缺乏共识，监管工作陷入停滞。 Lighthouse Reports 委托 ATNi 进行的研究表明，与澳大利亚和法国的类似系统相比，印度提议的标签系统实际上始终更为宽松。

与此同时，Instagram 上有影响力的名人制作了视频，比较方便面、婴儿食品等各种产品的营养成分。 他们被其所分析成分标签的公司起诉。
